text:
jessica.partnerships: Quick sync — EdgeCloud marketplace listing + Orbit SI integration readiness. Target launch Thu 4/16. Need press slot, microsite, and packaging signoff.

mike-marketing: On it. PR agency confirmed embargo 4/16 10:00 PT. Need final 1-pager by Tue EOD.

lisa-press: Please tag press contacts list. Also need embargo-approved quote from CEO.

sophie-se: Orbit SI integration tests passed on staging. Two last items: tenant onboarding script and sample deploy playbook.

dan-engineering: Packaging for hardware bundle needs a small tweak to startup script. I'll push fix tonight. ETA 11pm PT.

omar-legal: Licensing blurb approved. Still need confirmation on data residency text for EU launch.

jessica.partnerships: For marketplace listing we need SKUs + meter rates. @mike-marketing can you confirm the SKU IDs? Also who owns the landing page hero?

mike-marketing: SKUs: EC-COMPUTE-1, EC-COMPUTE-1-BUNDLE-HW. Metering slug: edgecloud.compute.hour. Landing hero: creative owns; julia will deliver hero image by Wed.

julia-creative: Confirmed. Will post assets to /shared/marketplace/edgecloud by Wed 9am PT. cc: @lisa-press

sophie-se: Quick note — sample deploy command for demo:

```
rcli deploy --provider=edgecloud --sku EC-COMPUTE-1 --region us-west-2 --si=orbit
```
Use that in the microsite walkthrough.

deploy-bot: Calendar invite created: "EdgeCloud Marketplace Launch Rehearsal" Thu 4/15 16:00 PT. link: https://cal.example/edge-rehearsal

mike-marketing: Press release draft v2 posted: https://docs.example/edge-pr-v2. Please review comments.

omar-legal: One more — remove "enterprise-ready" claim unless we include SLA line. Recommend: "SLA available with Redwood Dedicated" — ok?

lisa-press: Good catch. I'll update PR.

jessica.partnerships: Action items: Mike — finalize SKUs + 1-pager (Tue EOD). Julia — hero + assets (Wed 9am). Dan — runtime fix (tonight). Sophie — update demo CLI in microsite. Omar — finalize EU residency blurb. Lisa — PR final check and CEO quote. We'll do rehearsal Thu 4/15. Anything missing?

mike-marketing: Need partner co-announcement blurb from EdgeCloud marketing. @edge-pm can you drop a 2-sentence partner quote?

edge-pm: Thanks — posting now. "Partnering with Redwood brings predictable inference economics to EdgeCloud customers."

sophie-se: I'll run a final end-to-end test Wed morning and post results.

jessica.partnerships: Thanks all. If anything slips, flag here. :rocket:
